data.statement: Update the AudioMancer release, changelog, project metadata, and help-file versions consistently to 2.0.0, then run the full test suite.

acceptance: CHANGELOG.md retains a fresh Unreleased heading and publishes the former Unreleased content under version 2.0.0 dated 2026-07-30.
pyproject.toml, uv.lock, audiomancer.__version__, and the release-version smoke test all declare exactly 2.0.0.
The English and Romanian offline help titles, help-version labels, and application-version labels all declare exactly 2.0.0.
No authoritative 1.7.0 release metadata remains outside the historical 1.7.0 changelog entry.
The focused release-version check, Ruff, full configured pytest suite, traceability, coverage, documentation review, and delivery preflight pass.
assumptions: The existing Unreleased content is the 2.0.0 release body, and an empty Unreleased section remains above it for subsequent changes.
data.reason: The requested version is explicit, the release surfaces are already documented and covered by a smoke test, and the change does not alter runtime behavior or dependencies.
scope: In scope: CHANGELOG.md, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, audiomancer.__version__, the release-version smoke test, both offline help index files, a minimal durable release-version contract/spec, focused consistency checks, Ruff, and the full configured pytest suite. Out of scope: source behavior, dependency changes, compatibility work, packaging archives, tags, commits, pushes, or Gitea release creation.
